summary: Idaho County's 100-foot steel Aermotor lookout tower, built 1934 in the Nez Perce National Forest, was gone by 1969; a 1951 survey disk is on record.

facts.design: 100-foot steel Aermotor tower with an L-4 cab for living quarters; one source gives the model as Aermotor MC-40
facts.status_note: Gone by 1969 per firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service list.

staffing.status: one named lookout (Al Moore, January 1936 item); no fuller roster in the sources read

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as drive-up on national forest land; no closure or permit is described in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as drive-up. The only item on record at the site is the 1951 survey disk; whether it survives is not stated.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief lists a second coordinate pair (45.87323, -115.88403) that no page read supports. The NGS survey position (NAD 83(1992): 45 51 30.95 N, 115 53 47.50 W) works out to about 45.85860, -115.89653 by hand conversion, which matches the record's first pair. The record keeps 45.8586, -115.89653.

notes_for_editor: Read firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, Rex's page, the NGS datasheet QZ0745, and the Forest Service Nez Perce list (fs.usda.gov/media/259204). The FS table has an unlabeled 1953 cell in the Quartz Ridge row; not used. The 1962 USGS station description places the disk centered under the steel tower; the record does not say when the tower was removed beyond the 1969 date from three sources. Rex's page gives only Removed, no date. Access public is inferred from the drive-up label and national forest land. Staffing: only the January 1936 item is recorded; no other roster was found.
